WITH task_counts AS (
         SELECT t.run_id,
            t.family,
            t.status,
            t.family = 'P01'::text AND (t.kind = ANY (ARRAY['alpaca_stock_bars'::text, 'retained_reuse'::text])) AND COALESCE(t.scope ->> 'timeframe'::text, '1Min'::text) = '1Min'::text AS minute_alias,
            count(*) AS units,
            min(t.next_retry_at) AS next_retry_at
           FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 t
          GROUP BY t.run_id, t.family, t.status, (t.family = 'P01'::text AND (t.kind = ANY (ARRAY['alpaca_stock_bars'::text, 'retained_reuse'::text])) AND COALESCE(t.scope ->> 'timeframe'::text, '1Min'::text) = '1Min'::text)
        ), units AS (
         SELECT n.run_id,
            m.delivery_family,
            sum(n.units)::bigint AS planned_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = ANY (ARRAY['INGESTED'::text, 'NO_DATA_RETURNED'::text, 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text, 'PROVIDER_LIMITATION'::text, 'IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED'::text])), 0::numeric)::bigint AS terminal_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'INGESTED'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS ingested_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'NO_DATA_RETURNED'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS no_data_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS not_applicable_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'PROVIDER_LIMITATION'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS provider_limited_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'IDENTITY_OR_QUALITY_UNRESOLVED'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS unresolved_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'OPERATIONAL_ERROR'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS operational_error_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'BLOCKED_EXTERNAL'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS blocked_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'RETRY_WAIT'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS retry_wait_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'RUNNING'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS running_units,
            COALESCE(sum(n.units) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'PENDING'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS pending_units,
            min(n.next_retry_at) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'RETRY_WAIT'::text) AS next_retry_at
           FROM task_counts n
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT n.family AS delivery_family
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P02'::text
                  WHERE n.minute_alias) m
          GROUP BY n.run_id, m.delivery_family
        ), observations AS (
         SELECT p.run_id,
            m.delivery_family,
            count(p.task_id) AS archived_pages,
            count(v.task_id) AS verified_pages,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'P01'::text THEN v.rth_records
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'P02'::text THEN v.pre_records + v.post_records
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'D01'::text AND COALESCE(v.reused_feature_records, 0) > 0 THEN v.reused_feature_records
                    ELSE p.record_count
                END), 0::bigint) AS committed_records,
            COALESCE(sum(v.target_records), 0::bigint) AS dated_target_records,
            COALESCE(sum(v.support_records), 0::bigint) AS support_records,
            COALESCE(sum(v.unknown_date_records), 0::bigint) AS unknown_date_records,
            COALESCE(sum(v.unclassified_session_records), 0::bigint) AS unclassified_session_records,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'D01'::text THEN v.reused_feature_records::bigint
                    ELSE v.reused_records
                END), 0::numeric) AS referenced_existing_records,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'D01'::text THEN v.qualified_feature_records::bigint
                    ELSE v.reused_qualified_records
                END), 0::numeric) AS referenced_qualifying_records,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'D01'::text THEN v.usable_feature_records::bigint
                    ELSE v.reused_usable_records
                END), 0::numeric) AS referenced_usable_records,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'P01'::text THEN v.usable_rth_records
                    WHEN m.delivery_family = 'P02'::text THEN v.usable_pre_records + v.usable_post_records
                    ELSE 0
                END), 0::bigint) AS usable_minute_records
           FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2 p
             JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 t ON t.id = p.task_id AND t.run_id = p.run_id
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.family AS delivery_family
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT 'P02'::text
                  WHERE t.family = 'P01'::text AND (t.kind = ANY (ARRAY['alpaca_stock_bars'::text, 'retained_reuse'::text])) AND COALESCE(t.scope ->> 'timeframe'::text, '1Min'::text) = '1Min'::text) m
             LEFT JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 v ON v.task_id = p.task_id AND v.page_no = p.page_no
          GROUP BY p.run_id, m.delivery_family
        ), audits AS (
         SELECT backfill_family_ref03_v2.run_id,
            count(*) AS evidence_records
           FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_family_ref03_v2
          GROUP BY backfill_family_ref03_v2.run_id
        )
 SELECT r.id AS run_id,
    c.family,
    c.title,
    c.completion_basis,
    c.shared_source_family,
    COALESCE(u.planned_units, 0::bigint) AS planned_units,
    COALESCE(u.terminal_units, 0::bigint) AS terminal_units,
    COALESCE(u.ingested_units, 0::bigint) AS ingested_units,
    COALESCE(u.no_data_units, 0::bigint) AS no_data_units,
    COALESCE(u.not_applicable_units, 0::bigint) AS not_applicable_units,
    COALESCE(u.provider_limited_units, 0::bigint) AS provider_limited_units,
    COALESCE(u.unresolved_units, 0::bigint) AS unresolved_units,
    COALESCE(u.operational_error_units, 0::bigint) AS operational_error_units,
    COALESCE(u.blocked_units, 0::bigint) AS blocked_units,
    COALESCE(u.retry_wait_units, 0::bigint) AS retry_wait_units,
    COALESCE(u.running_units, 0::bigint) AS running_units,
    COALESCE(u.pending_units, 0::bigint) AS pending_units,
    COALESCE(o.archived_pages, 0::bigint) AS archived_pages,
    COALESCE(o.verified_pages, 0::bigint) AS verified_pages,
        CASE
            WHEN c.family = 'REF03'::text THEN COALESCE(a.evidence_records, 0::bigint)
            ELSE COALESCE(o.committed_records, 0::bigint)
        END AS committed_records,
    COALESCE(o.dated_target_records, 0::bigint) AS dated_target_records,
    COALESCE(o.support_records, 0::bigint) AS support_records,
    COALESCE(o.unknown_date_records, 0::bigint) AS unknown_date_records,
    COALESCE(o.unclassified_session_records, 0::bigint) AS unclassified_session_records,
    COALESCE(o.referenced_existing_records, 0::numeric) AS referenced_existing_records,
    COALESCE(o.referenced_qualifying_records, 0::numeric) AS referenced_qualifying_records,
    COALESCE(o.referenced_usable_records, 0::numeric) AS referenced_usable_records,
    COALESCE(o.usable_minute_records, 0::bigint) AS usable_minute_records,
    u.next_retry_at,
        CASE
            WHEN c.family = 'REF03'::text THEN 'CONTINUOUS_AUDIT'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(u.planned_units, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN 'NOT_PLANNED'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(u.operational_error_units, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(u.blocked_units, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'BLOCKED_EXTERNAL'::text
            WHEN u.terminal_units < u.planned_units THEN 'IN_PROGRESS'::text
            WHEN o.verified_pages < o.archived_pages THEN 'READBACK_PENDING'::text
            WHEN (u.no_data_units + u.not_applicable_units + u.provider_limited_units + u.unresolved_units) > 0 THEN 'COMPLETE_WITH_DOCUMENTED_GAPS'::text
            ELSE 'COMPLETE'::text
        END AS work_completion,
    'OBSERVED_COUNTS_ONLY_NO_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE_CERTIFICATE'::text AS coverage_basis,
    false AS counts_are_additive_across_families
   FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 r
     CROSS JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_family_catalogue_v2 c
     LEFT JOIN units u ON u.run_id = r.id AND u.delivery_family = c.family
     LEFT JOIN observations o ON o.run_id = r.id AND o.delivery_family = c.family
     LEFT JOIN audits a ON a.run_id = r.id;
